title: Lakehouse: backup take (mc mirror s3://warehouse)
description: Runs `nexus backup take lakehouse --yes`. Mirrors the warehouse bucket (the Iceberg/Spark data) to a node-local dir via `mc mirror` and reports the object count + size — a portable point-in-time copy (the S3 store itself is already EC-durable).
whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.BackupTakeAsync mc-mirrors the warehouse bucket to a node-local dir and reports the object count + byte size.
